title: Show that the count 1e-10000 has a 33220-bit denominator
body:
## Summary
- The spelling `1e-10000` has 8 characters, so a 60-character limit does not reject it. As an exact fraction it is `1/10^10000`, and that denominator has bit length 33,220.
- The published budget rejects a trailing decimal exponent whose absolute value exceeds 60. This exponent is `-10000`.
- `1e-60` stays inside the exponent budget and the `10^60` component limit, while `1e-61` does not. Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
